title: e_e (silent e)
parentNote: This finishes the set: every vowel has now had the silent e treatment, and today it is the e itself. One e, a consonant, then a quiet e — and the first e says ee, the sound your child met yesterday in bee and tree. Two things to know before you start. This spelling is genuinely rare, so today is a short list of words practised hard rather than a long one skimmed: Pete, Steve, Eve, theme, here. And most of them are names, which is not a cheat — names are where this pattern actually lives. The slip is the same as every silent e day: reading straight past the e, so Pete comes out pet and theme comes out them. Cover the last e with your finger, read the short word, lift the finger, read it again. Say both out loud yourself first; the difference is easier to hear than to explain.

activities.mouthCue: Lips wide in a smile, teeth almost shut: eee. The same sound as yesterday's bee.
activities.prompt: The e on the end says nothing. It reaches back over the t and tells the first e to say ee.
All three are made of e. One of them has a gap with a letter hiding in it.
All three have a gap and a quiet e. Listen to the vowel that goes in the gap.
Only two sounds. The v and the e go together and the e stays quiet.
Three sounds, not four. The t and the e go together at the end.
A theme is a tune that comes back. Two letters at the front, one sound.
The longest one. Two sounds crowd in at the front before the e.
Same three letters at the front. One of them has the silent e on the end.
Listen to the middle. Short e, or the e saying ee?
All three start with h and an e. The end of the word decides it.

activities.text: Pete and Steve did sit here in the grass and did not get up.
Here is a green tree, and up here is a big bee!
Did Eve get here on a bike? Eve did run!

activities.title: Eve up the tree
activities.prompt: Read the story one line at a time. Tap any word you want to hear again.
lines: Pete and Steve came here at three.
Eve is not here. Eve is up in the tree!
Eve did wave at them and did grin.
Then a big bee came, and Eve did not grin at it.
Steve did hum a theme, and the bee came at him!
Pete did set sweet feed on a flat stone.
The bee did shift off and sat on the feed.
Eve is back on the grass at last. But Pete is up the tree!
